decision_journal.root-cause: writeForeignFlowToOhlcv (apps/mcp-server/src/infrastructure/db/ohlcvForeignFlowStore.ts L58-69) BYPASSES writeOhlcvBatch and INSERTs a stub row open/high/low/close=0,volume=0 ON CONFLICT(code,date) when the foreign-flow fetch (gated to VN market open 02:00Z) arrives BEFORE the real OHLCV bar. taAlertScanJob/bbAlertScanJob CANDLE_SQL (SELECT close FROM daily_ohlcv WHERE date>=-60d ORDER BY day ASC) read that C=0 stub as TODAY latest candle: Wilder RSI with a final 0 after a ~27000 real close collapses to single-digit across ALL tickers simultaneously (CTG 3.4 / SSI 6.8 / VCB 3.7 on a +0.48% day = statistically impossible), and close=Math.round(0)=0 yields gia 0 duoi BB spam (msg 783-790, 02:15-03:15Z). Later the real OHLCV bar UPSERTs over the stub so canonical reads clean by 04:30Z. This is feedback_ohlcv_startup_purge_defeated_by_backfill_seeder: a re-seeding WRITER defeats the repair; fix the WRITER not the residue; trace ALL writers into daily_ohlcv (this was the un-migrated straggler).

(4) architect durable producer root (writer-SSOT across ALL bypass writers) PLUS dev consumer defense-in-depth guard, BOTH P0 — CHOSEN: kill the fake bar at the writer AND fail-closed at the reader.

entries.vision: Make /dashboard/prediction-claims update DAILY, not weekly. User: page not update many day, wants update continue day by day. ROOT CAUSE (router RAW-confirmed + PO-verified live): page + /api/prediction-claims + predictionClaimsHandler are HEALTHY — do NOT touch them. The DATA PRODUCER is starved: prediction_claims has only 9 rows, newest 2026-06-14 (agentId 08-prediction-synthesizer). The synthesis flow (digest-predict/flow/monday.md, P-3..P-5 create_prediction_claim) was DISABLED by Sprint 1949-T5 (Monday prediction synthesis removed — Sunday weekly covers full scope); the Sunday weekly.md flow only READS get_prediction_accuracy, it never calls create_prediction_claim. So NO active flow has produced a claim since 1949-T5 — the 06-14 batch was the last routed run. Live confirm: get_prediction_accuracy(30d)=no results; calibration Brier=0.1379 healthy (product is SOUND, just unfed).
entries.product_decision: Option (a) chosen: re-enable prediction synthesis on a DAILY cadence by routing digest-predict to a daily prediction sub-flow + a new daily cowork slot, WITHOUT disturbing the Sunday weekly calibration report. Daily update = a daily synthesis run that CREATES new high-conviction claims when fresh evidence appears AND lets existing open claims keep accruing toward their multi-day/weekly horizon (e.g. W26). It is NOT a forced 5-claims-every-day spam. GUARDRAILS (designed by architect first): (1) per-DAY cap (small, e.g. 2-3) replacing the monday max_prediction_claims_per_week:5, with a weekly ceiling so cadence cannot inflate claim volume; (2) same-day idempotency marker via task_claim (TTL ~20h) keyed on day+slot so a re-fire never double-creates; (3) NO-OP cleanly when no ticker passes the bullish/bearish>0.6 high-conviction filter (do NOT lower the bar to manufacture daily claims — standing no-fake-data directive); (4) Sunday weekly.md calibration report stays unchanged + un-regressed.
entries.success_metric: LIVE: prediction_claims gains new rows on consecutive (high-conviction) days; /dashboard/prediction-claims generatedAt + rows reflect them day-over-day; daily/weekly caps honored; flat-market day no-ops without fabricating claims; Sunday weekly MARKET calibration dish still fires unchanged. Verified raw vs named-volume DB, not a green build.

For EVERY Layer-A cron in the live CRONS map (apps/mcp-server/src/scheduler/cronConfig.ts — SSOT; read the map, NEVER hardcode the list/count): parse the cron expr (node-cron dep already present) to derive expected_last_fire + expected_next_fire; read actual last_fire + last_status from cron_job_runs via cronJobRunStore using the MAX(started_at)-per-job pattern (double-log immune — same oracle schedulerWatchdogJob uses); classify status via cadence x threshold PARITY with schedulerWatchdogJob WATCHDOG_MANIFEST (generalize the 16-job manifest to ALL Layer-A crons — do NOT diverge the threshold). Reuse get_cron_health's last_run/last_status where already computed; the new endpoint EXTENDS it with expected-vs-actual, it does not duplicate run-store queries. (2) dev-mcp-server: surface Layer-B CLI crons HONESTLY — read them from their SSOT (.claude/commands/crons/*.md + system-map.json + the cron-detect-loop / cron-cowork-team skills), label layer=cli-session, status=SESSION_SCOPED (never MISSED). (3) dev-frontend: api.cron-status.tsx proxy resource route (mirror api.orchestration.tsx) + a Cron Recheck Table on dashboard.orchestration.tsx. Columns (plain-Vietnamese user copy where appropriate): Ten cron / Layer / Lich du kien (human-readable from expr) / Lan chay gan nhat / Du kien lan toi / Trang thai (colored badge). A RECHECK button re-fetches/revalidates the loader live. Per-table freshness badge 'Cap nhat luc' per the shipped freshness-transparency pattern (SSOT frontend-data-coverage-map.json — never baked/client-now time). (4) qa gate.
entries.scope_out: NO new always-on cron/alerting (schedulerWatchdog already alerts — this is a READ-ONLY dashboard VIEW). NO auto-restart / auto-heal of crons from the UI (recheck is read-only). NOT changing any cron schedule or the CRONS map. NOT building a Layer-B run-tracking persistence store (session-scoped crons have no DB run rows BY DESIGN; surfacing them = label + last-known from skills SSOT, not new telemetry infra — deeper Layer-B telemetry is a follow-up). NOT reconciling/fixing individual broken crons (those are the existing FIX-CRON-* board tasks) — this sprint SURFACES status, it does not repair jobs.
entries.success_metric: RAW-demonstrable: (a) GET /api/cron-status returns 200 with one row per Layer-A cron DERIVED from the live CRONS map (row count == map size, NOT a hardcoded number), each row carrying {name, layer:server, cron_expr, human_schedule, expected_last_fire, expected_next_fire, last_fire, last_status, status in {ON_TIME,LATE,MISSED,STALE,NEVER_FIRED}}. (b) A cron with a fresh cron_job_runs success row within its cadence classifies ON_TIME; a job whose MAX(started_at) exceeds cadence x threshold classifies MISSED/STALE, PARITY-tested against schedulerWatchdogJob's verdict for the same job (no divergence). (c) Layer-B CLI crons render layer=cli-session + a NON-RED SESSION_SCOPED status — a CLI cron with no recent fire is NOT shown MISSED/failed. (d) /dashboard/orchestration renders the table without error; RECHECK re-fetches live; 'Cap nhat luc' badge shows the REAL fetch time; a never-fired cron shows 'Chua tung chay' not a fabricated timestamp. (e) NO regression to the existing orchestration task-board view or /api/orchestration.
entries.reuse_mandate: Anti-rebuild: CRONS map = SSOT for Layer-A exprs (read, never hardcode); cronJobRunStore MAX(started_at) = last-fire (double-log immune); schedulerWatchdogJob WATCHDOG_MANIFEST cadence/threshold = classification parity source (generalize, do NOT diverge); get_cron_health = existing last_run/last_status (extend, do NOT duplicate); orchestrationHandler.ts + api.orchestration.tsx = the exact REST+proxy pattern to mirror.
entries.standing_acs: Carries the standing gates: freshness 'Cap nhat luc' (SSOT frontend-data-coverage-map.json, never client-now); no-fake-data (honest-NULL: never-fired -> 'Chua tung chay', no fabricated timestamp); plain-Vietnamese user-facing copy (feedback_language_boundary — English for work artifacts); all-info source/detail affordance where a status needs explanation (why MISSED / why SESSION_SCOPED).

backlog.title: Same-tick CHEF mutual-exclusion in cowork dispatch — suppress non-guaranteed chef-* slots when a guaranteed chef slot matches the same tick, in BOTH pressure modes (closes legacy-mode cadence-bypass double-publish)
backlog.root_cause: Two independent gaps both fire on the once-per-weekday 05:15 nominal tick where chef-morning cron (15 5) and chef-intraday cron (13 2-8) coincide: (1) pressure-state.stale_warning=true (DETERMINISTIC — cycle-snapshot age > _staleness_threshold_minutes=20, correctly reporting stale data) forces PRESSURE_MODE=legacy at Step 4.2; legacy mode sets CADENCE_MATCHES = raw MATCHES with NO filtering (pressure-cadence.md Step 4.5b), so the cadence gate that would have suppressed chef-intraday (off-market default 240min vs ~62min elapsed) is bypassed. (2) No same-tick CHEF mutex: published-marker keys differ per slot (published:chef-morning:DATE vs published:chef-intraday:DATE:HH) so they never collide, and chef-intraday's conditional logic does not detect the guaranteed morning dish that published 0-1min earlier.
backlog.fix_spec: Fix A (robust, per payload §06:21Z): add an UNCONDITIONAL same-tick CHEF mutual-exclusion in the dispatch tick (runs in BOTH adaptive AND legacy modes, because legacy mode is entered LEGITIMATELY whenever pressure data is stale). After MATCHES is resolved (pressure-cadence.md Step 4.5b rebind, or match-slots.md Step 4b collision guard): if MATCHES contains a guaranteed chef-* slot (slot.guaranteed==true AND slot_id matches ^chef-), drop every non-guaranteed chef-* slot from MATCHES for that tick and log a suppression telemetry line. Do NOT touch emit_pressure_state / stale_warning (fix C) — the flag is deterministic and correctly reports stale snapshots; suppressing it would mask real staleness.

ARCHITECT DECIDES state location: board-row-exists check (no new state, cheapest) vs a content-fingerprint redispatch_count in signals.db (drain-signals.js already fingerprints the envelope; add a semantic-content variant).
